desc: Implement countSubstrings: initialize cnt as 10x10 zero table; for each char with value v, build nxt[d][(r*10+v)%d] += cnt[d][r] for d in 1..9, add 1 to nxt[d][v % d] for the substring starting at current position.
After updating each step, if v != 0, add nxt[v][0] to the answer; replace cnt with nxt; use lists of lists and local variable aliasing for speed (~8.1M inner ops for n=1e5).
Optional optimization: only track divisors d that actually appear in s (precompute digit set) to reduce the constant factor.
Verify against examples: "12936" → 11, "5701283" → 18, "1010101010" → 25; edge cases: "0" → 0, "7" → 1, "000" → 0, all-nines → n(n+1)/2, trailing zeros.
Write final solution in required format (countSubstrings method in code delimiters) with brief comments explaining the DP invariant.
